title: Dysregulation of naive T cell quiescence during Aging
description: TEA-seq (novel trimodal single-cell analysis of mRNA transcripts, surface protein epitopes, and chromatin accessibility) was performed on CD3+ T cells isolated from peripheral blood of healthy pediatric (11_13 yrs, n = 8) and older adult (55_65 yrs, n = 8) female donors.
